about_short_description.short_description: Fin provides insights to optimize customer operations across SaaS applications.

product.name: Global Money Movement Infrastructure
product.description: A stablecoin-based infrastructure platform for managing fiat and digital-asset payment flows, settlements, accounts, and transaction operations across multiple jurisdictions.

product.name: Cross-Border Payments
product.description: A payment service for sending and settling funds internationally through stablecoins and local currencies, with support for multiple payout corridors and reduced foreign-exchange handling.

product.name: Compliance
product.description: An API-enabled compliance service covering customer and business verification, anti-money-laundering checks, and regulated payment processing through Fin's licensing structure.

product.name: Wallets
product.description: White-label virtual wallet infrastructure with USD and EUR accounts, stablecoin support, payment capabilities, and local-currency off-ramp functionality.

product.name: Fin API and Integration Platform
product.description: A unified API and operational interface for integrating virtual accounts, payments, compliance workflows, reporting, and settlements into business applications.
